title: Actuarial Analyst
description_html:
We don't just provide health insurance—we deliver the kind of healthcare that people deserve. The Actuarial team at Clover combines rigorous analytics with innovative technology to solve complex healthcare challenges and improve outcomes for our members. Our actuaries play a critical role in driving financial performance, evaluating business strategies, and helping shape the future of Medicare Advantage.

We're looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious Actuarial Analyst to join Clover's actuarial rotational program. This role is designed to provide broad exposure to multiple actuarial disciplines while building a strong technical foundation in Medicare Advantage.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you'll work alongside experienced actuaries and business leaders on projects spanning financial forecasting, reserving, medical economics, pricing, value-based care, revenue and risk adjustment analysis, and operational strategy. Through rotational assignments, you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of the Medicare Advantage business while building the analytical, technical, and business skills needed for long-term success.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy solving challenging problems, working with large datasets, and using quantitative analysis to influence business decisions.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you will:

  • Perform quantitative analyses that support key actuarial functions, including financial forecasting, medical cost analysis, revenue optimization, reserving, pricing, risk adjustment, and value-based care initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain analytical models using actuarial principles, statistical methods, and large healthcare datasets to evaluate financial performance, identify trends, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Partner with actuaries and cross-functional business leaders to analyze operational and financial performance, investigate emerging trends, and develop data-driven recommendations.
  • Prepare reports, dashboards, and executive presentations that communicate complex analytical findings and support business planning, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
  • Support enterprise financial planning by analyzing medical costs, revenue drivers, risk adjustment performance, utilization trends, and other key business metrics across the Medicare Advantage business.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and automate analyses using SQL, Excel, Python, and other AI analytical tools.
  • Participate in rotational assignments across multiple actuarial disciplines to develop broad business knowledge and technical expertise while contributing to strategic initiatives across the organization.
  • Support special projects and innovation initiatives that improve healthcare affordability, operational performance, member outcomes, and enterprise financial results.

Success in this role looks like

  • In your first 90 days, you will: Build relationships across the Actuarial organization and become familiar with Clover's Medicare Advantage business. Learn Clover's analytical tools, financial models, and reporting processes. Contribute to recurring analyses while developing a strong understanding of actuarial methodologies and business operations.
  • After 6 months, you will: Independently own recurring analyses and deliver accurate, timely insights to support business decision-making. Develop technical expertise in actuarial modeling, healthcare analytics, and financial forecasting. Successfully complete your first rotational assignment while building relationships across multiple actuarial functions.
  • Future success in this role includes: Becoming a trusted analytical partner to business leaders and cross-functional teams. Developing expertise across multiple actuarial disciplines before transitioning into a specialized role. Continuing progress toward actuarial credentials while building a long-term career at Clover.

You should get in touch if you have:

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description_html:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

You'll join a two-person ML team and a forecasting system making half hourly demand predictions across diverse targets for multiple restaurant chains. Our forecasting models enter into a complex environment with key machine and human decisions being made on their predictions, facing feedback loops and a highly variable environment. The system works - the challenge now is scaling it from a handful of clients to 100s.

You'll own client launches end-to-end: validating data, selecting models, running UAT, going live, and monitoring performance afterwards. You'll join client calls, build relationships, and understand what actually matters on the ground - not just whether the model is accurate, but whether the kitchen prepped the right amount of food.

You'll love this role if:

  • You enjoy taking ownership of the product and outcome end-to-end. Machine learning at Sona is a success if we have happy clients running successful businesses as well as the models which are best in industry

  • You have a focus on solving the problem and when given the choice between "complicated and shiny" vs "get something simple in front of a user", you choose the latter

  • You're excited by working with our industry experts to really understand what's happening in our client's businesses and the realities of working there

  • You see beyond the data to the world that resulted in this data generating process, the issues that come with it and the opportunity that it gives us

  • You're experienced in and excited by taking a machine learning project from business idea to deployed production system

  • You default to AI tools for development and you're excited by what they can achieve for ML. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent daily - not as a novelty, but as your standard working mode

Our role won't be for you if:

  • You're hoping to do research and publish research papers as a key element of the work that you do

  • You're looking to move into a less technical, more managerial role

  • You're keen to get your hands on fancy new technology X and apply it to something

  • You prefer to work on one thing and make it perfect before moving on - the role requires pragmatism, parallelism, and iterative improvement

Requirements

You'll need these skills/experience to be successful:

  • Production ML experience, with a track record of deploying ML systems that handle messy data, fail gracefully, and need monitoring

  • Strong ML fundamentals - you can reason about trade-offs in practice, explain the "why" behind feature and model choices, and make good judgement calls when something unexpected happens

  • Client-facing deployment experience - you've personally owned an ML deployment end-to-end and are comfortable on calls with non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong programming skills in Python, including the ML/scientific Python stack (e.g. numpy, scikit-learn)

  • Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or equivalent) as your default working mode

It would be great if you have experience in some of these areas too:

  • Forecasting, time-series, or demand-planning - someone who understands lag features, calendar effects, and evaluation integrity intuitively will ramp significantly faster

  • Our stack: Python, scikit-learn, MLflow, Docker, GCP

  • A small team where ownership is wide and context-switching is normal

Benefits

  • Salary: £95,000-£110,000

  • Fully remote (European timezones)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Co-working space stipend for those based outside London

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

title: Decision Scientist
description_html:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

The Decision Scientist at Instructure will contribute to how data informs strategic decisions across the organization. This is a foundational role within a growing decision science capability, offering the opportunity to apply analytical rigor to meaningful business problems in an EdTech environment.

Impact of the Role

As a Decision Scientist, you will support data-driven decision-making across Instructure by delivering high-quality analyses and partnering with cross-functional teams.

In this role, you will:

  • Support business impact through data-driven insights. Conduct analyses that uncover opportunities to improve product adoption, customer engagement, and revenue growth using rigorous analytical methods.

  • Execute experimentation and causal analysis. Support the design and execution of A/B tests and causal inference studies to evaluate the impact of new product features, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives.

  • Contribute to product and business strategy. Partner with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to translate business questions into structured analytical frameworks and deliver clear, actionable findings.

  • Deliver analytical solutions end-to-end. Own the lifecycle of analytical projects — from scoping problems and building models to presenting insights and tracking outcomes.

  • Apply AI-first thinking. Leverage AI tooling (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Glean) to accelerate analysis, improve throughput, and elevate the quality of deliverables.

  • Communicate insights clearly. Translate analytical findings into recommendations that both technical and non-technical stakeholders can understand and act on.

What You Will Need

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field (PhD is a plus).

  • 2–4 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related discipline with demonstrated ability to deliver actionable insights.

  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning fundamentals, and experimental design (A/B testing).

  • Familiarity with AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean) to improve productivity.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.

  • Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, modeling, and visualization.

  • Proficiency in a Business intelligence tool (Tableau, PowerBI... etc.)

  • Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Fivetran).

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to present complex analyses clearly.

  • Experience in SaaS, product analytics, or EdTech environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

title: Payments GTM (Go-to-Market) Operations and Strategy Lead
description_html:
Please note the internal job title is: Principal Payments GTM Operations and Strategy

Want to build the go-to-market engine for a fast growing payments business?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead to be part of our Fintech department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

The team:

We’re building the financial backbone for field service businesses. Our Fintech team is one of the most strategically important and fastest growing parts of Jobber. We help businesses get paid, access capital, understand their financial health, and ultimately stay in business longer.

The future of financial services is embedded, and we’re still early. Small businesses increasingly rely on vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber not just to run their operations, but to manage their money. Payments is the foundation of everything we do in Fintech, and how we go to market with our Get Paid products (invoicing, payments, instant payouts, etc) is the single biggest lever we have to grow the business.

This role will own how Jobber’s payments business grows. Think of this as running the commercial side of a payments business inside a SaaS company.

The role:

Reporting into the VP & GM, Payments and Fintech you will establish Payments GTM Operations as a new function at Jobber. You will bring together every team that touches payments go-to-market (Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, Risk, Operations, Analytics, Product Development) and build the programs, processes, and measurement that turn these teams into a coordinated growth engine.

The job has two objectives: help more customers discover and get value from Jobber’s payments products, and accelerate revenue growth for the business.

Day to day, the Payments GTM Operations and Strategy Lead will identify opportunities, design programs, and run experiments to drive adoption and usage of Jobber’s payments products. This will include:

  • Mapping and rebuilding the end-to-end customer journey for payments, from first touch through activation and ongoing usage, working closely with cross-functional partners. This includes identifying where customer-facing teams (sales, post-sales, support) can change their motions to drive better outcomes.

  • Experimenting with a range of actions (e.g. incentives) to drive payments adoption and usage, rapidly iterating based on results.

  • Defining the metrics that matter for payments GTM and holding yourself (and cross-functional partners) accountable to them.

  • Building deep working relationships across GTM teams, Product, RevOps, Analytics, etc. You are the connective tissue between these teams on payments GTM.

  • Using data and qualitative insights to find opportunities, size them, run experiments, and measure results.

  • Staying close to what other vertical SaaS and embedded payments players are doing. Knowing where Jobber can differentiate.

To be successful, you should have:

  • Operating and strategy experience, ideally a mix of both:

    • Operating experience: you have experience identifying opportunities, mobilizing teams, and driving measurable results. Could be Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Strategy & Operations, Product Commercialization, or a GM/Founder role, ideally at a scaling SaaS or Fintech company.

    • Strategy experience (valued): you have been a strategic partner to senior leaders, making data-driven recommendations. Examples could be Management Consulting, VC, or Strategy & Operations.

  • Deep understanding of payments and financial services business models, metrics, and growth strategies is desirable, particularly financial services for small businesses.

  • Strong data instincts. You use analytics to measure impact, make decisions, and optimize performance. You are not just comfortable with data, you reach for it first.

  • Experience using languages such as SQL to manipulate large data sets is a plus, but not required.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across GTM teams, Product, Executive Leadership, etc. You translate data into stories and strategies into action plans.

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable operational processes that enhance efficiency and ultimately drive growth.

  • Passion for helping small businesses succeed through innovative financial solutions.

  • A curious mind and a growth mindset. You are a scrappy learner who can quickly become an expert and build new capabilities.

  • A proactive drive to solve problems. You are capable of bringing structure to ambiguous problems, corralling resources, and delivering results.

  • A preference for working in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect from time to time. This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Employees who live in one of our hub cities - Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo will participate in their department's in-office schedule, while employees outside our hub cities will work remotely.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200 a midpoint of $177,900 and a maximum salary of $204,500 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

  • A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

  • A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

  • A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

  • To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
description_html:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Instructure is seeking a strategic, highly analytical, and execution-oriented Sr. Revenue Operations Manager (Sales Operations) to support and accelerate growth across our International and Channel business. This is a highly visible role that sits at the center of Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, helping shape go-to-market strategy and operational execution across multiple regions and business units.

As a trusted business partner to sales leadership, you will lead forecasting, territory and capacity planning, performance analysis, pipeline strategy, and operational cadences that drive predictable revenue growth. You will play a critical role in turning data into actionable insights, identifying growth opportunities, optimizing resource allocation, and improving overall sales productivity and efficiency. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable operating strategically with senior leadership and rolling up their sleeves to solve complex operational problems.

THIS POSITION CAN BE WORKED REMOTELY ANYWHERE IN THE UK OR FROM OUR UK OFFICE

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and drive sales forecasting, pipeline management, bookings analysis, and performance measurement processes across International regions to ensure alignment against revenue targets and strategic objectives.

  • Partner directly with regional sales leadership to develop and execute growth strategies, optimize territory coverage, improve pipeline generation, and increase sales productivity.

  • Lead strategic planning initiatives including territory segmentation, quota setting, capacity modeling, whitespace analysis, and coverage optimization to support scalable growth.

  • Analyze sales performance trends, pipeline health, conversion metrics, seasonality, and customer behavior to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.

  • Develop executive-level reporting, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership, QBRs, forecasting reviews, and board-level discussions.

  • Build data-driven models and business cases using Salesforce, Snowflake, Tableau, Excel, and other data sources to inform operational and strategic decisions.

  • Identify process gaps and drive automation and operational improvements that increase reporting accuracy, forecasting predictability, and organizational efficiency.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Deal Desk, and other GTM teams to ensure alignment across planning, reporting, and execution.

  • Evaluate sales motions, customer journey metrics, and funnel performance to improve pipeline velocity, conversion, retention, and expansion opportunities.

  • Support and influence compensation planning, incentive alignment, and operational governance initiatives that reinforce company objectives and sales behaviors.

  • Operate as a trusted advisor and thought partner to leadership by bringing clarity, structure, and actionable insights to complex business challenges.

  • Manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and execution quality.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, Business Analytics, or related functions within a SaaS or high-growth technology environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with advanced experience in Salesforce, Excel/Google Sheets, Tableau, etc., and data platforms such as Snowflake.

title: Customer Support Specialist III
description_html:
About Us:

Wrapbook is a smart, intuitive platform that makes production payroll and accounting easier, faster, and more secure. We provide a unified payroll platform that seamlessly connects your entire team—production, accounting, cast, and crew—all in one place. Wrapbook empowers production teams to manage projects, pay cast and crew, track expenses, and generate data-driven insights, while enabling workers to manage timecards, track pay, and onboard to new projects from any device. Wrapbook brings clarity and dependability to production payroll, while increasing the productivity of your whole team.

Trusted by companies of all sizes, Wrapbook powers payroll for some of the industry’s top production companies, including SMUGGLER, Tuff, and GhostRobot. Our growing team of 250+ people across the USA and Canada, including entertainment and technology experts from SAG-AFTRA, DGA, IATSE, Teamsters, Amazon, Microsoft, Facebook, and more. Wrapbook is backed by top-tier investors, including Jeffrey Katzenberg’s WndrCo, Andreessen Horowitz, and A* Capital. We have raised $130M and are in a strong financial position.

The Opportunity – Customer Support Specialist III (Remote - US)

We are looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Specialist III to join our Support organization. In this role, you’ll ensure our crew members and client users have their product questions answered and technical issues resolved quickly, accurately, and with care.

Customer Support Specialist III's at Wrapbook work across a range of case types—from high-volume, repeatable issues to complex, high-context production scenarios. Depending on business needs and your strengths, you may be aligned to a team focused on Worker users and scaled support (Express Desk) or a team focused on non-Worker users and high-touch, relationship-driven support (Partnership Team). In all cases, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring payees are compensated compliantly and on time, while delivering a concierge-quality support experience.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of cases and inbound interactions (email, live chat, and phone via Salesforce), serving as the primary point of contact from first touch through resolution for crew members and client users.

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot product behaviors and production workflows: investigate issues, reproduce bugs, identify root cause, and advise on next steps or workarounds.

  • Manage your case backlog with clear ownership and urgency: prioritize work by customer impact, SLA, and escalation risk; proactively follow up internally and externally until issues are fully resolved.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Payroll Ops, Product, and Engineering to resolve customer issues, translating customer context into actionable technical detail.

  • Identify trends and product gaps: log high-quality bug reports and product requests in Linear (or similar tools), including replication steps and business impact.

  • Escalate urgent or production-critical issues via PagerDuty or established escalation channels and help coordinate cross-functional response through resolution.

  • Deliver a concierge support experience: adapt communication style to the customer and situation, explain solutions clearly, and anticipate follow-up needs.

  • Contribute to team knowledge and operational excellence by creating and maintaining SOPs, templates, troubleshooting guides, and other internal documentation.

  • Support continuous improvement efforts by sharing best practices, surfacing opportunities for workflow optimization, deflection, or automation, and incorporating QA feedback into your day-to-day work.

  • Mentor and support junior teammates as needed through case guidance, escalation support, and modeling strong customer judgment and communication.

What you’ll have

  • 2+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or an administrative role supporting film and television production (or equivalent B2B SaaS experience).

  • Strong knowledge of Film & Television production workflows; Production Accounting or payroll experience is highly valued.

  • Confidence communicating with customers via phone, email, and live chat, including comfort being on the phone for extended periods when needed.

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document customer issues clearly and create effective internal tickets and documentation.

  • Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a habit of researching, validating, and understanding solutions before communicating them.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a case queue responsibly, multitask across multiple issues, and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfort working in an early-stage, high-growth company where priorities evolve and adaptability matters.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally and a genuine enjoyment of working with others to achieve shared outcomes.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Linear (or similar bug tracking tools), PagerDuty, Slack, and Notion (or the ability to learn them quickly).

Nice to have

  • Motion Picture Union Payroll experience.

  • Experience supporting high-volume case environments or complex, high-sensitivity customer scenarios.

  • Experience creating or maintaining SOPs, workflows, or training materials for support teams.

  • Experience identifying deflection opportunities, improving self-serve resources, or contributing to automation initiatives.

  • Experience contributing to QA programs, mentoring junior support staff, or supporting team enablement.

  • Experience creating operating procedures or content for AI-powered support tools.

Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

  • Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

  • Learning and Development opportunities

  • Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

Apply Now

Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly!

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du bringst 15 - 20 Stunden pro Woche mit und unterstützt unser Team bei der Weiterentwicklung und Vermittlung von Fachwissen rund um erneuerbare Energien und digitale Schulungsinhalte.

Dabei übernimmst du unter anderem:

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Schulungsunterlagen und Lerninhalten
  • Eigenständige Recherche und Aufbereitung von Themen aus dem Bereich erneuerbare Energien
  • Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Durchführung von Schulungen
  • Präsentation von Schulungsinhalten vor kleinen Gruppen
  • Ansprechpartner*in für Anwenderfragen rund um das Tool Elephant
  • Abstimmung und Kommunikation mit dem Elephant-Team
  • Analyse von Fehlern und Nutzerfeedback sowie Mitarbeit bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Inhalten
  • Unterstützung bei organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben im Schulungsumfeld


Deine Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis und Interesse an Energiethemen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Spaß daran, Wissen verständlich aufzubereiten und weiterzugeben
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau)
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau)
Nice to have: 
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit KI-Anwendungen oder digitalen Lernplattformen
  • Erfahrungen mit Elephant oder vergleichbaren Schulungsplattformen
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Schulungen, Workshops oder Präsentationen


Deine Benefits

  • Der Teamspirit unter uns ist wirklich einzigartig: Dich empfängt ein familiäres Team, das Dich nach zwei Tagen vergessen lässt, dass Du neu bist
  • Wir sind Fans von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, pragmatischen Lösungen und ehrlicher Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
  • Dich erwarten Benefits wie ein Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, eine kostenlose Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club und Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • Deine Work Life Balance ist uns wichtig, deswegen bieten wir Dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Home Office zu arbeiten. Dein Hund ist im Büro auch willkommen!
  • Im Süden von Köln, direkt am Rhein, findest du deinen neuen Arbeitsplatz – bestens erreichbar durch die Bahnhaltestelle direkt vor der Tür. Die Dachterrasse mit Domblick bietet dir zudem den idealen Ort für Erholung und frische Ideen.
  • Wir wollen uns mit Dir weiterentwickeln: gemeinsam schmieden wir Pläne für Deine Karriere bei uns und setzen die Pläne in die Tat um
  • Durch unser nachhaltiges Geschäftsmodell in der Photovoltaikbranche bieten wir Dir eine sinnvolle Tätigkeit und die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben

title: UI / UX Designer untermStrich (m/w/d) – Hamburg
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Everii Germany Gmbh 3
description_html:
Work @ everii

Du begeisterst dich für B2B SaaS Software? Dein TikTok- und Insta-Feed ist voller UI-Inspirationen? Du weißt, dass Software nicht nur funktional sein muss, sondern auch ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen sein sollte. Bist du stets am Puls der Zeit, was die neusten Trends im Bereich Software-Design angeht?

Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!


Was dich erwartet

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von untermStrich, unserer ERP-SaaS-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von untermStrich und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.
Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Perfect Match!


Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für untermStrich, unsere ERP-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Architektur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Architektur-, Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.
  • Bonus-Skill: Hast du bereits Erfahrung mit untermStrich oder kennst du die Arbeitswelt von Architektur- und Planungsbüros? Dann ist das ein echtes Plus – aber kein Muss.


Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück. 
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).


Kontakinfos

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich!

description_html:
Work @ everii

Du begeisterst dich für B2B SaaS Software? Dein TikTok- und Insta-Feed ist voller UI-Inspirationen? Du weißt, dass Software nicht nur funktional sein muss, sondern auch ein Ort zum Wohlfühlen sein sollte. Bist du stets am Puls der Zeit, was die neusten Trends im Bereich Software-Design angeht?

Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!


Was dich erwartet

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von TEAMBOX, unserer ERP-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und projektbasierte Dienstleister.
Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von TEAMBOX und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.

Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! 
Perfect Match!


Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für TEAMBOX, unsere All-in-One-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleister.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.
  • Bonus-Skill: Hast du bereits Erfahrung mit TEAMBOX oder kennst du die Arbeitswelt von Agenturen und projektbasierten Dienstleistern? Dann ist das ein echtes Plus – aber kein Muss.


Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück. 
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).


Kontakinfos

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio & deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich!

title: Senior Software Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Gridfuse
description_html:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Contabo
description_html:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Cloud Product Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first (within Germany), but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Cloud Product Manager at Contabo, you're stepping into a role that doesn't come around often: you help build a new product from the ground up – a greenfield venture inside an established company, expanding our portfolio into a new market segment. You are the voice of the market and our customers: you establish feedback channels with customer and support teams, translate market and customer needs into a compelling product vision, and take end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap – from high-level planning through prioritisation to delivery, in close alignment with our PMO.

You work in a small, focused team of experts where speed matters: build fast, test fast, learn fast – with AI tools firmly embedded in our daily work, enabling the pace a venture like this demands. You refine ideas until the development teams can implement them with confidence, sequence roadmap items for maximum impact, and shape the best possible user experience together with your UX tandem partner. You don't shy away from technical discussions – you seek them out: you understand the product architecture across the full stack and keep asking "why" until even hidden blockers are on the table – and resolved quickly.

Because the product is new but the company isn't, you hook into existing processes – in finance and infrastructure, for example – and build new ones where gaps remain. You present progress and updates to stakeholders across development, sales, support, marketing, and leadership, acting as their central point of contact. In the medium term, you establish a product-driven roadmap spanning at least two years, along with KPIs that make the platform's success measurable. The role is built for a high degree of autonomy: you report directly to the Head of Product and work independently, driven by results – with no micromanagement, in either direction.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • Extensive senior-level experience in product management, ideally in a cloud or IT infrastructure environment 
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a product roadmap – from strategy through to delivery, not just in a supporting role 
  • A solid technical understanding of cloud-native architecture (containers, Kubernetes, microservices, cloud infrastructure) – you can hold your own in discussions with developers 
  • Experience with data-driven prioritisation and A/B testing, as well as agile frameworks (Scrum or similar) 
  • Proven experience acting as the central point of contact between engineering, sales, support, and leadership 
  • Confident, natural use of AI tools in your daily work – from product ideation to everyday tasks 
  • A high degree of independence and composure in a greenfield environment full of ambiguity – you don't need a task list, you create it 
  • The ability to quickly build deep understanding of new domains, products, and technologies 
  • Experience with pricing and packaging (a plus) 
  • Professional fluency in English (our working language); German language skills, product management certifications (e.g. CSPO, Pragmatic Institute), and a degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering are a plus

Join our innovative team at thermondo as a Product Manger (f/m/d and make a significant impact in reducing carbon footprints in private households.

What we have to offer

title: (Senior) AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Legalhero
description_html:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process
  • Your application as an AI Product Engineer (Senior) - short and to the point
  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team
  • Approx. 60-minute in-person interview with your hiring manager
  • Approx. 30-minute discussion with the management team
  • A prompt job offer
Your contact: Nadine · HR Manager ·

title: Internship Go-to-Market Engineering, AI & Automation (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

Dein Impact

Starte Deine Karriere im Software Vertrieb mit einem Praktikum bei autarc. 

Standort: Berlin, Invalidenstraße
Zeitraum: 6 Monate, Start im Januar 2027

  • Du vertreibst unsere innovative SaaS-Softwarelösung an Inhaber von
    Heizungsbau- und PV-Unternehmen und ermöglichst ihnen, ihre Planungs- und Vertriebsprozesse zu vereinfachen
  • Du kontaktierst pro-aktiv Geschäftsführer interessanter Unternehmen, vereinbarst Software-Demos und 
    erklärst, wie sie mit autarc ihre Prozesse vereinfachen und automatisieren können
  • Du kümmerst Dich eigenständig um den gesamten Sales-Cycle – vom Erstkontakt über den
    Sales Pitch bis zur Aktivierung und Abrechnung der Accounts
  • Du pflegst selbstständig und pflichtbewusst unser CRM-System, und hältst alle aktuellen
    Leads bis zum Abschluss auf dem Laufenden
  • Du trägst die Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von KPIs, erstellst Reportings und sorgst dafür,
    dass wir unsere Sales-Ziele erreichen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Gründerteam zusammen


Requirements

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt oder im Startup Umfeld
  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und motiviert, schon im Praktikum deine eigenen Kunden zu gewinnen  
  • Du bist gut organisiert, bringst proaktiv neue Ideen ein und treibst den Fortschritt selbstständig voraus
  • Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und kannst Gespräche so steuern, dass sie zu dem von
    Dir gewünschten Ergebnis führen
  • Du hast Interesse am Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien oder brennst darauf in diesem Bereich dazuzulernen
  • Du sprichst deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift


Was wir bieten

  • Ein bezahltes Praktikum mit der Möglichkeit, durch Provisionen gut dazuzuverdienen
  • Growth-Mindset: Werde Teil eines ehrgeizigen und motivierten Teams in einem schnell wachsenden Climate Tech-Startup – finanziert von führenden Venture Capitalists und Business Angels.
  • Echte Verantwortung: Übernimm eigenständig die Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Startups.
  • Dynamische Organisationsstruktur: Bringe deine Lebenssituation optimal mit deiner Arbeit in Einklang, mit Schwerpunkt auf flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Lösungen und Work-Life-Balance.
  • Büro in Berlin-Mitte: Unser Büro liegt in der Nähe des Weinbergsparks in Berlin-Mitte.
  • Modernes Equipment: MacBook und 27” Bildschirm. 
  • Jährliches Team-Retreat: Teilnahme an einem jährlichen Retreat mit dem gesamten Team.
  • Kollegiales und familiäres Team: Ein kollegiales und familiäres Team heißt dich willkommen, geprägt von einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.
  • Teil der Energiewende: Sei ein Teil der Energiewende und erlebe den Impact deiner täglichen Arbeit direkt.


Next steps

  • Bewirb dich online mit einem aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf.
  • Dein Ansprechpartner ist Philipp Hulm (Sales Lead DACH)

title: GTM UK – Internship / Working Student
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Autarcenergy
description_html:
Company

Founded in Berlin, autarc is a 55 person start-up which graduated from Y Combinator in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations and we serve more then 2.000 customers in Germany. 

Our next step is to expand into new countries and the UK market is next – that is why we are looking for a motivated and ambitious Intern to join our team in Berlin.



Role description

You will be working alongside the GTM Lead and the Sales team with hands out tasks around our expansion. This internship has a specific focus on sales, business development and product expansion. 

  • Hands on support of our sales team in their day-to-day work, including customer contact
  • Develop our sales decks and marketing material
  • Take part in events, fairs and customers visits on-side in the UK
  • Support the development of AI and automation tools that improve our effectiveness
The role has a 75/25 split between operational tasks & strategic topics. Anticipated starting date for this 4-6 months internship would be 1st of January 2026.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics or software engineering
  • Previous startup, consulting or VC experience
  • Fluent in English
  • Based in Berlin with a willingness to work hybrid (office in Mitte)


What we offer

  • Freedom to choose your own equipment
  • An annual team retreat
  • The choice between Dance or Deutschland Ticket for mobility 
  • Urban Sports Club for fitness
  • Regular team events, lunches and activities


Next steps

If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:

  • Screening call with someone of the sales team
  • Culture fit call with Thies (Co-Founder)
  • Take home case study (approx. 1 hour)
  • Final on-site interview with the team

title: Werkstudent Disposition & Kundenkommunikation (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Deutsche GigaNetz GmbH
description_html:
Unser Angebot

  • Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen:  
    Mit dem Wellpass kannst du deutschlandweit günstig in Fitnessstudios trainieren oder auf unseren beiden Booten auf der Alster segeln. 
  • Für deine tägliche Portion Vitamine ist gesorgt: In unseren Büros findest du kostenfreie Obstkörbe. 
  • Freie Getränke nach deinem Geschmack: Ob Limo, Saft oder Kaffee – bei uns hast du die Wahl, inklusive einer hochwertigen Barista-Kaffeemaschine. 
  • Mobil und nachhaltig unterwegs: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschlandticket, damit du umweltfreundlich und günstig unterwegs bist. 
  • Studium und Arbeit vereinbaren: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir und deinem Studienleben passt 
  • Unterstützung für viele Lebenslagen: Unser Partner, das Fürstenberg Institut, steht dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. 
  • Einkaufen mit Vorteil: Über unsere Corporate Benefits kannst du zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen zu vergünstigten Konditionen erwerben. 
  • Teamspirit: Wir sind ein erfahrenes Team, das mit viel Spaß zusammenarbeitet und gemeinsam Großes bewegt. 
  • Unsere Kultur: Bei uns duzt man sich – wir leben eine offene und flache Hierarchie. 
  • Zentrale Lage und moderne Arbeitsplätze: Unsere Büros liegen im Herzen von Hamburg, in bester Citylage. 


Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest Serviceanfragen und Vorgänge eigenverantwortlich in unseren Ticketsystemen und gewährleistest eine hohe Servicequalität.
  • Du koordinierst eingehende Aufträge und planst die Einsätze unserer Techniker:innen effizient und bedarfsgerecht.
  • Du überwachst und disponierst Termine in unseren Planungssystemen und stellst einen reibungslosen Ablauf sicher.
  • Du verantwortest die Nachbearbeitung von Einsätzen und unterstützt bei der Klärung offener Sachverhalte.
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen und koordinierst Terminvereinbarungen sowie Terminänderungen professionell und serviceorientiert.


Anforderungen

  • Du bist aktuell in einem wirtschaftlichen oder technischen Studiengang eingeschrieben.
  • Du gehst sicher mit Microsoft Office um und verfügst insbesondere über gute Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint sowie idealerweise Microsoft Project.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und behältst auch in dynamischen Situationen den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän, trittst serviceorientiert auf und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Interessen professionell zu koordinieren.
  • Du überzeugst durch Eigenmotivation, Lernbereitschaft und eine Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Erste Berufserfahrung oder praktische Einblicke in die Telekommunikationsbranche sind von Vorteil.


Konnten wir Dich überzeugen?

Warum du dich für uns entscheiden solltest?

  • Zukunftsbranche: Glasfaser ist das Rückgrat der Digitalisierung – und du kannst ein Teil davon sein.
  • Top-Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen dich auf deinem Karriereweg – mit Schulungen, Mentoring und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Digitale Prozesse, hybride Arbeitsmodelle und ein motiviertes Team warten auf dich.
  • Gemeinschaft & Teamgeist: Wir feiern Erfolge zusammen – egal ob beim Sommerfest oder in der Mittagspause.
Hört sich spannend an? 
 
Deine Einzigartigkeit ist bei uns willkommen! Bewirb Dich jetzt!
Bereichere unser Team aus motivierten Spezialisten mit Deinem Know-how! Wir heißen dich gerne willkommen in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen überhaupt.
 
Nutze unser Online-Bewerbungsformular in dem Du auf "JETZT BEWERBEN" klickst.
Solltest Du noch unsicher sein oder Fragen haben, dann melde Dich gerne direkt bei uns unter  
 
Wir freuen uns, von Dir zu hören!
