salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Towa
description_html:
Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

  • AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
  • SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
  • Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
  • Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.
  • Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt.
  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein.
  • Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
  • Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.
  • Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast.

  • Ein Thema mit Zukunft: AI Search ist keine Nische, die wieder verschwindet. Was du hier lernst, ist in zwei Jahren ein gesuchtes Profil und du kannst dann belegen, dass du von Anfang an dabei warst.
  • Echte Betreuung: Feste Ansprechperson, wöchentlicher Jour fixe, Zwischen- und Abschlussfeedback. Kein „Melde dich, wenn du was brauchst“.
  • Übernahmeperspektive, ehrlich benannt: Wir bauen dieses Feld auf und suchen parallel auf Senior-Level. Wenn es passt, ist der Weg über Junior in eine der beiden Rollen realistisch – wir versprechen es nicht, aber wir meinen es.
  • Teamspirit pur: Kollegiale Teams mit echtem Zusammenhalt, Hilfsbereitschaft und einer guten Portion Humor.
  • Transparente Strukturen: Flache Hierarchien und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität – Austausch auf Augenhöhe ist selbstverständlich, auch als Praktikant:in.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir bekommen Studium und Praktikum zusammen. Prüfungszeiten planen wir ein, wenn du sie früh sagst.
  • Mobility & Events: Öffi-Ticket-Zuschuss, Teamevents und die Chance, auf Fachkonferenzen mitzufahren.
  • Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern ausgestattet – mit Raum für Austausch, Ideen und natürlich Snacks & Drinks.

Diese Position ist ein Praktikum im Consulting Cluster von TOWA. Die Vergütung beträgt 1.800 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Vollzeitbasis. Bei einem Teilzeit-Modell wird der Betrag aliquot angepasst.

Im Einklang mit der EU-Entgelttransparenzrichtlinie (2023/970) und den länderspezifischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzen veröffentlichen wir für jede Rolle die Gehaltsspanne und fragen Kandidat:innen nicht nach ihrem aktuellen oder vorherigen Gehalt. Unsere Kriterien zur Gehaltsfestlegung – Cluster, Level, Skills, Verantwortungsbereich und Erfahrung – gelten unternehmensweit einheitlich. Du kannst während des gesamten Prozesses jederzeit schriftlich weitere Informationen zur Gehaltsspanne dieser Rolle oder zu unserer Vergütungspolitik anfordern.

Chancengleichheit

TOWA stellt nach Skills und Impact ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Hintergrund, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Die Stellenbezeichnung gilt für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d).

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliq
description_html:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wandelbots GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

description_html:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Account Executive focusing on the Maritime sector across Germany and Switzerland, you will be instrumental in expanding Kpler’s footprint in one of Europe’s most dynamic market regions. Working within our Mid-Market EMEA team, you will drive new account acquisition and uncover high-impact expansion opportunities by connecting commercial leaders with actionable data intelligence. In this role, your expertise will directly influence how maritime organizations make critical global trade decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new account acquisition across Germany and Switzerland to consistently meet and exceed annual revenue targets.

  • Uncover and execute strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to maximize customer lifetime value.

  • Partner with cross-functional commercial teams to support territory forecasting, demand planning, and multi-year strategic goals.

  • Gather direct customer and market feedback to provide actionable product and competitive insights back to internal strategy teams.

  • Maintain rigorous CRM data hygiene in Salesforce to ensure transparent pipeline reporting and accurate revenue forecasting.

  • Represent Kpler externally with authority and professionalism, positioning our data solutions as essential for maritime industry leaders.


    • Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves):

    • 5+ years of commercial sales experience with a track record of driving new logo acquisition in a Senior AE role.

    • Proven background selling B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or data intelligence solutions to corporate stakeholders.

    • Native or professional fluency in both German and English.

    • Strong negotiation skills combined with a proactive "hunter" mindset to independently develop and close high-value pipeline.

      • Nice-to-haves:

      • Direct commercial experience or domain knowledge within the maritime or global commodities trading sectors.

      • Hands-on proficiency with modern revenue enablement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

      • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Business Development Representative Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Akur8
description_html:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems.

Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.

As Akur8 continues to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Representative Intern to support our Sales team in identifying relevant prospects and creating new conversations with insurance professionals.

You will join an international Sales team focused on growing Akur8’s client base through new business, account development, and long-term relationships. You will work closely with Sales Directors, Sales Executives Marketing, Sales Operations, and our Actuarial experts. This internship will give you practical experience in B2B SaaS sales, prospecting, and the insurance technology market.

Your mission will include, but not be limited to, the following:

PROSPECT RESEARCH

• Identify insurance companies, reinsurers, brokers, and other relevant organisations that may benefit from Akur8’s solutions.

• Research target accounts, their business priorities, and the people involved in pricing, reserving, actuarial, data, and innovation projects.

• Build and maintain clear account lists to support focused outreach.

OUTBOUND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Write personalised email and LinkedIn messages that speak to each prospect’s role and business context.

• Support outbound calling and follow-up campaigns with guidance from experienced sales colleagues.

• Test different messages, channels, and approaches, then share what you learn with the team.

LEAD QUALIFICATION AND HANDOFF

• Engage with prospects to understand their current processes, challenges, priorities, and potential timelines.

• Qualify early conversations against agreed criteria and identify relevant next steps.

• Schedule meetings for Account Executives and prepare clear handover notes so that each conversation starts with useful context.

SALES AND MARKETING COLLABORATION

• Work with Marketing on campaigns, webinars, events, and content aimed at insurance professionals.

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve messaging and campaign targeting.

• Support the Sales team with account mapping, event preparation, and follow-up activities.

• Support the preparation of client-facing slides and materials, review documents created by the team, and adapt content to address specific client needs.

CRM AND REPORTING

• Keep prospect and activity information accurate in the CRM.

• Track outreach, responses, meetings, and follow-up actions.

• Prepare simple activity reports and contribute ideas to improve the team’s day-to-day sales process.

You will be based in Paris and will work primarily from our office. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, events, or conferences.

We are looking for someone who is curious about business, comfortable speaking with new people, and ready to learn through practice.

EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

• You are currently enrolled in a Business School, university, or equivalent programme and are looking for a full-time 6-month internship, with a starting date between October and December.

• You are interested in B2B sales, technology, insurance, or a role that combines business conversations with analytical thinking.

• You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you are comfortable adapting your message to different audiences.

• You are organized, persistent, and able to manage several follow-up tasks without losing track of details.

• You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and respond well to feedback.

• You enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions.

• You have strong spoken and written English & French. Additional language is a bonus.

BONUS SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• A first experience in sales, business development, customer service, or another role involving outreach.

• Familiarity with a CRM, sales engagement platform, LinkedIn, or other tools used to research and contact prospects.

• Previous experience in an international company, student association, start-up, or technology environment.

• An interest in the insurance industry and in the way data can support better business decisions.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Monthly compensation

  • Top-notch laptops & equipments

  • Lunch vouchers

These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision-making. description_html:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

We are seeking a Director of National Accounts!

About the Job

The Director of National Accounts plays a key leadership role in driving strategic growth across Access’ high-value national clients and prospects. This person will develop and execute account strategies designed to expand revenue, strengthen client loyalty, and deepen long-term partnerships.

This role is highly focused on proactive business development, cross-market collaboration, and ensuring national account strategies are executed consistently across local teams. The Director will serve as both a strategic partner and relationship leader, representing Access at the highest levels of client engagement.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a national account pipeline exceeding $12.5M annually, driving progress against revenue, new business, and account growth goals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that strengthen year-over-year relationships and expand client share-of-wallet.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders, gathering insights and ensuring proposals and deliverables align with their priorities.

  • Represent Access in the field, supporting local teams and maintaining strong client engagement across markets.

  • Prepare strategic presentations, manage RFP responses, and ensure timely, thoughtful follow-up with clients and prospects.

  • Partner closely with National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless and consistent client experience.

  • Influence teams across markets to execute national strategies effectively, even without direct reporting authority.

  • Use market intelligence and industry trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic account plans.

About Access

Access is a destination management company that designs shared experiences for some of the world’s most recognizable brands. From intimate incentive trips to large-scale meetings, trainings, and sales-driven events, we bring people together through thoughtful design, smart sourcing, and seamless execution. Our work blends imagination with intention. We dream big, then we build it right.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 7+ years of successful sales and account management experience within the DMC, hospitality, or a related industry.

  • Experience leading large, multi-market national or enterprise accounts.

  • Demonstrated ability to generate $3.5M+ in self-generated business annually.

  • Experience navigating complex account relationships, multiple decision makers, and enterprise-level buying processes.

  • Strong financial and business acumen, including pipeline management, forecasting, profitability, and budgeting considerations.

  • Advanced negotiation experience involving MSAs, large-scale program contracts, and complex service agreements.

  • Executive presence and confidence working with senior-level stakeholders across Procurement, Marketing, Sales Leadership, and the C-Suite.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Experience mentoring sellers or contributing to team development and best-practice sharing.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • National Accounts deliver consistent revenue growth while meeting or exceeding defined revenue, new business, and gross profit goals.

  • Strategic account plans lead to deeper client engagement, stronger relationships, and increased share-of-wallet.

  • Clients view Access as a trusted strategic partner, resulting in repeat business, multi-year partnerships, and strong feedback.

  • National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional partners work together seamlessly to deliver consistent service across destinations.

  • Competitive opportunities are supported through strong client engagement, strategic presentations, and timely RFP responses.

  • You represent Access with professionalism and credibility, strengthening our reputation and presence in the marketplace.

Why Access?

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work – 3 years in a row and counting!

  • 55+ years in the industry!

  • Women-owned and women-led

  • Fun, creative, and supportive culture

  • Focus on recognition and employee value – including annual and quarterly awards

  • Paid day off to serve your local community

  • Annual all-company retreat to connect, learn, and have fun together

  • Annual qualifier-based incentive trip for top performers (certain departments eligible)

  • Regional team outings

  • Monthly companywide meetings to connect, learn, and celebrate wins

COMPENSATION

  • Highly competitive total compensation, including strong base salary and quarterly bonuses

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

WORK LIFE BALANCE

  • Flexible schedule opportunities

  • Generous PTO

  • Sick days

  • 9 full holidays

  • 5 half days off prior to holidays to unplug early

  • 2 floating holidays off to be used on holidays of your choice

  • ½ day Fridays in July & August (based on achievement of goals)

HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FAMILY

  • Extensive menu of health plans to choose from

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance program

  • Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Mentorship program

  • “Masterclasses” in industry/department-specific topics

  • State-of-the-art technology platforms and tools – including training

  • Annual and monthly meeting content that focuses on professional development

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Developer (Java/Spring Boot) based in France.

Join a fully remote product development team working on modern digital products for ambitious organizations.
You’ll build reliable backend systems, APIs, services, integrations, and database solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
Your work will contribute directly to production features, with ownership extending from implementation through testing and release.
You’ll collaborate closely with frontend, QA, DevOps, product, design, and client-side stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.
The role offers meaningful autonomy while encouraging developers to challenge assumptions, communicate risks, and understand the wider product context.
You’ll work on a project currently expected to run through February 2027, with the opportunity to apply modern engineering practices in a distributed team.
This is an excellent fit for a mid-level backend engineer who values clean code, strong collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning.


Accountabilities

  • Develop clean, maintainable, testable, and efficient backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services for frontend applications and other systems.

  • Develop and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, indexes, migrations, data models, and persistence layers using Hibernate/JPA.

  • Translate product and business requirements into robust backend functionality and well-structured business logic.

  • Develop and maintain microservices within distributed backend architectures.

  • Implement third-party integrations, internal services, and other backend integrations based on project requirements.

  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, validation, and correct handling of edge cases.

  • Write and maintain automated tests and collaborate closely with QA engineers to ensure appropriate feature coverage.

  • Take ownership of assigned backend features from implementation through testing, release, and delivery.

  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, product managers, designers, and other backend developers to deliver complete product features.

  • Identify and communicate unclear requirements, technical risks, dependencies, and potential blockers early.

  • Participate in code reviews, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows.

  • Contribute to improving engineering practices, code quality, maintainability, and team processes.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of professional backend development experience.

    • Strong practical knowledge of modern Java development; experience with Java 21 is preferred.

    • Hands-on experience building backend applications and services with Spring Boot.

    • Practical experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM-based persistence.

    • Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query performance.

    • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and consuming RESTful APIs.

    • Practical experience with automated backend testing and a strong understanding of testing as an integral part of software development.

    • Comfortable using Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.

    • Familiarity with microservices and distributed systems.

    • Experience with Domain-Driven Design or Event-Driven Architecture is a plus.

    • Familiarity with AWS or another cloud environment is advantageous, particularly experience with ECS/Fargate.

    • Experience in Fintech, SaaS, HR, Payroll, ERP, AI-enabled products, or complex enterprise platforms is beneficial.

    • Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to manage assigned features independently while knowing when to involve others.

    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into reliable, well-structured backend solutions.

    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar is a bonus.

    • Fluent professional English is required.

    • Spanish language skills are a significant advantage, particularly for collaboration with LATAM stakeholders.

title: Product Marketing Lead, Billing

description_html:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we're a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It's faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We're backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and owns product marketing for the Billing product group. You will work across Product, Growth, Revenue Marketing, Sales, Finance, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and Brand to turn customer insight into a clear story, a strong go-to-market plan, and measurable market impact.

Monetisation becomes harder as software businesses grow. Pricing models, subscriptions, payments, invoicing, and revenue operations can become a patchwork that slows launches, creates risk, and pulls teams away from their customers.

You will turn a complex commercial problem into a clear story for the people who buy, build, operate, and grow software businesses. You will own the product-area narrative and execution, while partnering with cross-functional teams on broader company positioning, category strategy, and major commercial decisions.

What you'll do

  • Build customer and market insight through research, customer conversations, usage signals, competitive intelligence, and commercial feedback.

  • Define positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, and the product story for your product group.

  • Lead high-impact launches, commercial initiatives, and change programs from early strategy through readiness, channel activation, adoption, advocacy, and learning.

  • Build focused go-to-market plans across the channels that matter, with clear audiences, owners, trade-offs, and measures.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Support early enough to influence priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer outcomes.

  • Equip Revenue Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and partners with clear stories, talk tracks, proof, and practical guidance.

  • Bring competitive and market insight into product, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market decisions, and identify opportunities to sharpen differentiation.

  • Set objectives and measures for customer adoption, retention, and commercial impact. Make practical recommendations using data and opportunity sizing to highlight the business and customer opportunity.

  • Use AI to improve research, synthesis, analysis, competitive intelligence, workflow automation, and product marketing quality, with strong judgement and verification.

We'd love to hear from you if you are

  • A track record of bringing complex B2B, fintech, payments, billing, infrastructure, or platform products to market.

  • Experience leading high-impact launches, migrations, packaging changes, or commercial initiative with measurable results.

  • Strong customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, storytelling, and commercial judgement.

  • The ability to connect product detail to outcomes such as growth, retention, efficiency, flexibility, and confidence.

  • Comfort working with technical, product, finance, operations, sales, solutions, support, and executive audiences.

  • Range across launches, enablement, adoption, change management, measurement, competitive insight, and customer advocacy.

  • Examples of using AI, agents, or automation to improve speed, quality, or insight.


What good looks like
Within your first year, the Billing team has a sharper product story, a repeatable approach to launches and commercial change, stronger enablement, and a clear view of what is driving customer adoption and business impact. Product and go-to-market partners trust you to bring clarity, make smart trade-offs, and turn insight into action.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle
At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. We're more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you'll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don't match every part of the job ad, especially if you're part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there's anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We're committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let's grow together.

Our Values

Paddle Together - "None of us, is as smart as all of us"

Paddle Simply - "Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple"

Paddle for others - "We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs"

Why you'll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a 'digital-first' company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving environments while demonstrating strong SaaS metrics, ROI modelling, and contract negotiation skills.

  • A track record of transitioning leadership scope from Mid-Market into Enterprise tiers.

description_html:

📅 Initial 3 month FTC - potential option for extension or perm.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

description_html:
The Company

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities. We bring together leading minds to share the latest trends, challenges and opportunities facing companies, the tactics and tools needed to drive results, and a forum to make meaningful connections.

Our Alliance brand is renowned for its VIP dinners, exclusive breakfasts, and bespoke 1-2-1 meeting packages designed to bridge supply and demand across various verticals. Join our dynamic team and drive sales to new commercial prospects, creating valuable connections and driving business growth.

The Role

We’re looking for a commercially driven VIP Event Sponsorship Sales Executive to take ownership of our high-level, invitation-only dinner series and related bespoke experiences.

You’ll focus on selling sponsorship packages to top-tier B2B brands looking to engage with senior audiences through intimate, content-driven environments. These conversations often serve as the entry point to broader partnership discussions, including full-series or multi-event sponsorships, making this a role with both immediate and strategic impact.

You’ll work closely with our wider event sponsorship team to identify opportunities, open doors, and nurture long-term commercial relationships that span across our community portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Executive Event Sales: Lead sponsorship sales for The Alliance’s portfolio of exclusive, invite-only dinners and professional experiences.

  • New Business Development: Proactively identify, target, and secure sponsorship opportunities with prospective clients across both existing Alliance communities and new markets.

  • Client Outreach & Relationship Building: Re-engage existing clients from our digital and event portfolios, cultivating long-term sponsorship partnerships.

  • Revenue Growth: Consistently deliver new business revenue through proactive outreach, pitching, and closing bespoke event sponsorship deals.

  • Consultative Sales Approach: Understand client objectives and position bespoke event solutions that deliver tangible ROI.

  • Market Insight & Opportunity Creation: Stay ahead of B2B event trends to spot new opportunities, feeding insights back to product and event teams.

  • Pipeline Management: Maintain disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and consistent progress toward monthly and quarterly targets.

  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with events, marketing, content, and community teams to ensure flawless delivery of sponsorship packages.

  • Reporting & Feedback: Provide regular sales performance updates, client feedback, and market insights to inform ongoing strategy.

Requirements
If the below sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you:

  • Proven track record in event or sponsorship sales, ideally within B2B, media, or conferences.

  • You have a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with enterprise customers

  • You’ll be determined and focused, and enjoy the challenge of hunting and closing net new business

  • Tough targets won’t scare you and you’ll have a demonstrable track record of not just meeting them - but exceeding them

  • Confidence to experiment with different tactics, shake up strategy, adapt to new trends, to incorporate new products, changes, or to bounce back from subpar results

  • You want ownership in your role from the beginning and ready to level up.

  • You expertly balance and prioritise your daily to-do's, as well as your short-term and long-term planning

  • Experience with Asana or project management tools a plus (desirable)

Location: This role can be either Hybrid in our London office or completely remote across the UK (not abroad).

Salary: Base Salary range £32K - £38K (*Based on previous experience) - OTE £70K+

_______________________

Benefits

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

  • Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

  • WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget

  • A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office

Health & wellbeing

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa

  • Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary

  • On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill

  • Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes

  • Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes

  • Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts

  • Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you

Learning & development

  • A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year)

  • Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

  • Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.
If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.
We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

With offices in London, New York, and Shanghai and a team of 100 people, we connect a vast global network of buyers and providers through our market-leading platforms and specialist consulting - and by providing a clear view of the data landscape, we help organisations navigate complexity and find their competitive edge. Joining Neudata really puts you at the heart of the fintech industry, where your work directly influences the data-driven strategies of the world's most sophisticated organisations.

The Role:

We're looking for an Account Director (New Business) to take our Scout and Ranger platforms to data buyers across EMEA and APAC: hedge funds, asset managers, private equity firms and the fast-growing world of AI. This is a pure new business role, and you'll own your territory end to end, from spotting the opportunity through to signing the deal.

You'll be the face of Neudata in front of some of the most sophisticated investors in the market, running story-led demonstrations, guiding hands-on trials alongside our research analysts, and building relationships with the people who decide how their firms use external data. There is real scope to grow the role too, including the potential to manage an SDR or a wider SDR team as the territory develops.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Own a European and Asia-Pacific territory of institutional investor prospects, driving new business through proactive outreach, field trips and lead generation campaigns across email and social

  • Run the full sales cycle: leading discovery and qualification calls, delivering value-based, story-led demonstrations of Scout and Ranger, then negotiating commercial terms and closing in line with quota

  • Manage hands-on platform trials in partnership with our research analysts, aligning technical and business criteria so prospects can see the value for themselves

  • Represent Neudata on stage and on the ground, presenting at our own high-profile events and at external conferences in the UK and overseas

  • Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, from Heads of Data and portfolio managers through to procurement leads

  • Keep your pipeline sharp with rigorous CRM discipline and accurate forecasting, and feed market insight back to our product and research teams to help shape where we go next

What You'll Bring:

  • Strong experience in data, research or information sales, ideally into financial services, with a proven track record of originating and closing complex new logo deals

  • A real understanding of how investment firms buy, particularly asset managers and hedge funds, and of the stakeholders involved along the way

  • Sharp commercial acumen and the confidence to negotiate and close

  • Outstanding presentation and communication skills, in person and online, in front of senior and technical audiences alike

  • Genuine enthusiasm for alternative data, market data and investment research, and curiosity about where the data landscape is heading

  • Experience coaching or managing SDRs is a bonus

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days' annual leave, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year 📅

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing) ✚

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 👨‍👩‍👧

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST 📈

  • Employee referral bonus of £1,000 per successful new hire you refer 💸

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate) with hybrid working. Frequent travel across Europe, the Middle East and North America is anticipated

description_html:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

We are seeking a Director of National Accounts!

About the Job

The Director of National Accounts plays a key leadership role in driving strategic growth across Access’ high-value national clients and prospects. This person will develop and execute account strategies designed to expand revenue, strengthen client loyalty, and deepen long-term partnerships.

This role is highly focused on proactive business development, cross-market collaboration, and ensuring national account strategies are executed consistently across local teams. The Director will serve as both a strategic partner and relationship leader, representing Access at the highest levels of client engagement.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a national account pipeline exceeding $12.5M annually, driving progress against revenue, new business, and account growth goals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that strengthen year-over-year relationships and expand client share-of-wallet.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders, gathering insights and ensuring proposals and deliverables align with their priorities.

  • Represent Access in the field, supporting local teams and maintaining strong client engagement across markets.

  • Prepare strategic presentations, manage RFP responses, and ensure timely, thoughtful follow-up with clients and prospects.

  • Partner closely with National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless and consistent client experience.

  • Influence teams across markets to execute national strategies effectively, even without direct reporting authority.

  • Use market intelligence and industry trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic account plans.

About Access

Access is a destination management company that designs shared experiences for some of the world’s most recognizable brands. From intimate incentive trips to large-scale meetings, trainings, and sales-driven events, we bring people together through thoughtful design, smart sourcing, and seamless execution. Our work blends imagination with intention. We dream big, then we build it right.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

  • Executive presence and confidence working with senior-level stakeholders across Procurement, Marketing, Sales Leadership, and the C-Suite.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Experience mentoring sellers or contributing to team development and best-practice sharing.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

  • National Accounts deliver consistent revenue growth while meeting or exceeding defined revenue, new business, and gross profit goals.

  • Strategic account plans lead to deeper client engagement, stronger relationships, and increased share-of-wallet.

  • Clients view Access as a trusted strategic partner, resulting in repeat business, multi-year partnerships, and strong feedback.

  • National Sales, local offices, and cross-functional partners work together seamlessly to deliver consistent service across destinations.

  • Competitive opportunities are supported through strong client engagement, strategic presentations, and timely RFP responses.

  • You represent Access with professionalism and credibility, strengthening our reputation and presence in the marketplace.

Why Access?

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work – 3 years in a row and counting!

  • 55+ years in the industry!

  • Fun, creative, and supportive culture

  • Annual qualifier-based incentive trip for top performers (certain departments eligible)

  • Regional team outings

  • Monthly companywide meetings to connect, learn, and celebrate wins

COMPENSATION

  • Highly competitive total compensation, including strong base salary and quarterly bonuses

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

WORK LIFE BALANCE

  • Flexible schedule opportunities

  • Generous PTO

HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FAMILY

  • Extensive menu of health plans to choose from

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Mentorship program
